To report the editor-requested non-redundant HSF motif numbers using exact coordinate uniqueness as the principal metric, while retaining the earlier any-overlap merged analysis as a stringent sensitivity check.
Within each sequence/window, predictions with identical 1-based start/end coordinates are collapsed across HSF PWM models and strands. Different start or end coordinates remain distinct.
HSF-family intervals are merged transitively when they overlap by at least one nucleotide; adjacent but non-overlapping intervals remain separate.
For copy-wide ONSEN scans, reverse-strand positions were converted to forward-sequence coordinates before coordinate comparison and strict overlap merging.
Both metrics indicate computational sequence compatibility with HSF-family PWMs; neither demonstrates experimental HSF binding or occupancy.

Native 49-bp HSE window: 20 principal motif-coordinate placements and 1 strict overlap-merged region. Across the sixteen Col-0 ONSEN 800-bp terminal windows: 33–49 principal placements (median 39.5) and 7–10 strict overlap-merged regions.
